name: url_inspect
short_description: Inspect URL index status in Google
full_description: Inspect the live Google index status, crawl status, canonical URL, and rich results for a URL (Google quota: 2,000/day per site).

account_id.description: Connected Google account ID. Obtain it from accounts_list.

site_url.description: GSC property URL, e.g. "https://1flowbase.taichuy.com/" (with trailing slash) or "sc-domain:example.com".

inspection_url.description: Full URL inside the site property to inspect.

language_code.description: Optional BCP-47 language code for localized issue messages, e.g. "zh-CN" or "en-US".
